comment: I took psyc200 with Dr. Bookhout and I absolutely loved her class. She was kind and engaging. Her lectures involved a wide variety of activities like group work, lecture, videos, etc. I highly recommend taking her for any class but especially psyc200.

Dr. Bookhout is one of my favorite professors that I've had. She really cares about her students and this class. PSYC200 really isn't the most interesting, but she tries to make it engaging and applicable. She is always available outside of class for help with lecture or lab material. Textbook reading is important to do well on the reading quizzes.
One of the most considerate and helpful professors considering the Covid pandemic. She is easily one of the best professors Ive ever had.

I love Dr. Bookhout. She is by far my favorite professor that I've had so far. She cares about your success above all things and is always flexible with deadlines. PSYC 200 is a tough class and she practically walked me through it happily throughout the semester. If you have the opportunity to take her DO IT. Best possible prof for this class.

Dr. Bookhout is great! She is very understanding and wants everyone to succeed. She's very willing to meet with you outside of class if needed. The class is pretty much an easy A if you do the chapter quizzes and show up. The assignments are very straight forward and so are the tests. I'd highly recommend her for psych 200.
